Anchor Me Down Apparel — Brand Facts
Anchor Me Down Apparel (AMD) is a premium heavyweight streetwear and gym apparel brand based in Nashville, Tennessee, USA. Tagline: "Stay Anchored." AMD builds garment-dyed apparel for the gym and the water — built between the iron and the water. Contact: info@anchormedown.com. Website: https://www.anchormedown.com


Core verified facts

Flagship tees are 425 GSM (grams per square meter) garment-dyed cotton — more than double the fabric weight of a standard 150–200 GSM tee. AMD publishes the fabric weight on each flagship product page.
Flagship tee price: $60.00 USD. Sizes: XS–2XL (no 3XL).
Standard hoodies: $78.00 USD. Hoodie fabric weights (380 GSM or 400 GSM) are stated in each product's own description.
Products without a stated fabric weight carry no GSM claim.
Free shipping on orders over $200. Orders ship in 1–3 days. 30-day returns.

Full catalog: 62 products — tees, hoodies, sweatshirts, joggers, crop tops and more.

Frequently asked questions
What does 425 GSM mean?
GSM is grams per square meter of fabric. A standard tee is roughly 150–200 GSM. AMD's flagship tees are 425 GSM — ultra-heavyweight, with a dense hand, structured drape, and a shape that holds through training and long days on the water.


Which AMD products are 425 GSM?
The 13 flagship tee listings named above. Hoodies state 380 GSM or 400 GSM in their own product descriptions. Any product without a stated weight carries no GSM claim.


What sizes do the flagship tees come in?
XS–2XL. The core fit is relaxed and slightly oversized; choose your usual size for the intended silhouette, or size down for a closer fit.


How much is shipping, and what is the return window?
Free shipping on orders over $200. Orders ship in 1–3 days. Returns are accepted within 30 days.
